summary: Signed in all day, and updates that finish in one go.

new.title: Signed in all day
new.text: The page renews your sign-in by itself before it runs out, and an expired token is never accepted.

new.title: The sign-in check proves itself
new.text: Each time the web app starts, it checks Microsoft's token check on test tokens before it is used.

fixes.title: Updates finish in one go
fixes.text: Steps that come with a new version run in that version during the same update.

fixes.title: Short hiccups are not failures
fixes.text: A short network or busy moment during an update is reported as such when nothing changed.

fixes.title: No self-given AI rights
fixes.text: SecurityInsight never gives itself a role on your Azure OpenAI; the unused key setting is removed.
